projects.title: Barangay Health Records System
projects.proponents: Ana Reyes, Carlo Mendoza, Liza Tan
projects.description: Digital patient records and check-up history for barangay health centers.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a web-based health records system for barangay health centers that replaces paper logbooks with a searchable database of residents, check-ups and immunizations.

Health workers can register residents, record consultations and print monthly reports for the city health office. The system aims to shorten record retrieval time and reduce lost or duplicated records.

projects.title: Smart Classroom Attendance Tracker
projects.description: RFID-based attendance logging with a web dashboard for instructors.
projects.abstract:
This study presents an RFID-based attendance system for classrooms that automatically records student presence when an ID card is tapped on a reader.

Attendance logs are stored in a MySQL database and shown in a web dashboard where instructors can view, filter and review attendance per class session. The system aims to reduce manual checking, save class time and improve the accuracy of attendance records.

projects.title: Campus Event Management App
projects.proponents: Jessa Cruz, Rafael Ong, Nina Bautista, Leo Garcia
projects.description: Android app for announcing, registering for and checking in to campus events.
projects.abstract:
This study presents an Android application that lets student organizations publish campus events, accept registrations and check attendees in with QR codes.

Organizers see live headcounts while students receive reminders before each event. Results show faster check-in and higher attendance than paper sign-up sheets.

projects.title: Online Enrollment Assistant
projects.description: Guided online enrollment with subject advising and slot monitoring.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a web application that guides students through enrollment step by step: checking prerequisites, suggesting a block schedule and showing remaining slots in real time.

The registrar can monitor enrollment progress per program. Testing showed fewer advising errors and shorter enrollment lines.

projects.title: Rice Leaf Disease Detection Using CNN
projects.description: Identifies common rice leaf diseases from a phone photo.
projects.abstract:
This study trains a convolutional neural network to recognize four common rice leaf diseases from smartphone photos, reaching 93% accuracy on a held-out test set.

A simple web interface lets farmers upload a photo and receive the likely disease with treatment advice from the Department of Agriculture.

projects.title: Flood Alert SMS Notification System
projects.proponents: Miguel Santos, Jomar Dizon, Kate Salazar
projects.description: Water-level sensors that text residents when flooding starts.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a low-cost water-level monitoring device that sends SMS alerts to registered residents when flood levels cross set thresholds.

Readings are also uploaded to a dashboard for the barangay disaster office, helping responders act earlier during heavy rain.

projects.title: Pharmacy Inventory and Point-of-Sale System
projects.description: Stock tracking with expiry alerts and a fast checkout counter.
projects.abstract:
This study presents an inventory and point-of-sale system for small pharmacies that tracks stock by batch, warns about medicines nearing expiry and speeds up checkout with barcode scanning.

Owners receive daily sales and low-stock reports.

projects.title: Salita: A Tagalog Learning Game for Kids
projects.description: A word-building adventure game for Grade 1–3 learners.
projects.abstract:
This study presents an educational game where young learners build Tagalog words to unlock levels in a story set in a Filipino town.

Teachers can view progress per learner. A two-week classroom trial showed higher vocabulary scores than the control group.

projects.title: Thesis Archive Chatbot
projects.description: Ask questions about past theses in plain language.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a chatbot that answers questions about past theses in the college library, such as finding related studies by topic, adviser or year.

The bot uses intent classification and keyword search over thesis abstracts.

projects.title: Clinic Appointment Scheduler
projects.description: Online booking and queue management for a university clinic.
projects.abstract:
This study presents an online appointment and queue system for a university clinic. Students book a slot, receive a queue number and get notified when it is their turn.

Clinic staff see the day's schedule and walk-in queue on one screen.

projects.title: Library Book Reservation System
projects.description: Lets students reserve books and track due dates.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a web-based system that lets students reserve library books online and track due dates.

It aims to reduce waiting time at the library counter and help students avoid overdue returns through clear reservation status and due-date reminders.

projects.title: Campus Parking Slot Finder
projects.description: Ultrasonic sensors show free parking slots on a mobile app.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a parking guidance system that detects occupied slots with ultrasonic sensors and shows free slots on a mobile app in real time.

It aims to reduce the time drivers spend circling the campus parking area.

projects.title: CCS Alumni Tracer Portal
projects.description: Tracks graduates' employment for accreditation reports.
projects.abstract:
This study presents a portal where CCS graduates update their employment status so the college can produce tracer study reports for accreditation.

Charts summarize employment rate, time-to-hire and job alignment per batch.

projects.title: Scholarship Tracking Portal
projects.description: Scholarship applications, requirements and grade monitoring in one place.
projects.abstract: This study presents a portal where students apply for scholarships, upload requirements and see their application status, while the scholarship office monitors grade requirements each semester.

projects.description: Suggests capstone topics based on a student's interests and past projects.
